items.title: Fabio & Grooverider to receive Innovator Award at AIM Independent Music Awards
items.content_text: The drum & bass pioneers will be recognised for their contribution to UK music and club culture at next month's ceremony.

items.title: Technics announces limited-edition SL-1200 to mark 55th anniversary
items.content_text: The turntable will be limited to 12,000 units and released globally next month.

items.title: 'Totally shameless rip-off': Unlicensed version of Randomer's 'Bring' appears on DSPs
items.content_text: The new release is credited to Hungarian artist Bandera and vocalist Blue Cartez.

items.title: London venue TOLA issues statement following burglary
items.content_text: The Peckham space said thieves took alcohol, equipment and card readers, but it plans to remain open and is asking customers to bring cash.

items.title: Liverpool DJ and former club owner Kyle Chase absconds from prison
items.content_text: Chase, who formerly ran Spray Shop, was serving a 12-year, eight-month sentence for drug trafficking.

items.title: This week's top stories: RIP Moné, Yves Tumor and Reggie Watts allegations
items.content_text: We round up five key stories from the last few days.

items.title: Mix Of The Day: Mutual Identities
items.content_text: A masterclass in live electronics.

items.title: Mix Of The Day: Campmasters
items.content_text: Sweltering gqom grooves.

items.title: Mix Of The Day: Midirama & Raphael Kosmos
items.content_text: A sprawling five-hour b2b recorded live at Fuchs2.

items.title: Reason Studios makes Reason Rack free
items.content_text: The free plugin includes 15 instruments, effects and creative utilities, including Europa, Kong and Scream 4.

items.title: Reggie Watts dropped from festivals in wake of Rolling Stone investigation
items.content_text: The comedian and musician has been removed from lineups in the US, UK and Ireland following allegations concerning the death of his former partner.

items.title: The Art of Sound: Notting Hill Carnival
items.content_text: Carnival's 30-plus sound systems have collectively shaped the blueprint of Black British dance music. Explore Channel One's custom-built cabinets and Deviation's thunderous stacks—two of the very best.

items.title: Playlist: Houghton 2026
items.content_text: Listen to 118 tracks that the RA team heard on the ground at this year's festival.

items.title: William Basinski announces new album Passing the Cup of Sorrows
items.content_text: The piano record is the composer's first solo outing in six years.

items.title: Emilia-Romagna venue Meet Compact Club locked out of home amid legal dispute
items.content_text: The Cervia space said its electricity was cut in January following a change of ownership, with a court hearing scheduled for September.

items.title: Warp announces second Providenza Ensemble residency in Corsica
items.content_text: Mabe Fratti, Clarissa Connelly and Mark William Lewis will each compose a new work for 30-piece string ensemble during the September residency.
